messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: build on rstan on jenkins
parts:
Now rstan is built on Jenkins periodically.  So please do not be surprised to receive emails about failing to build. 

Daniel, you can change the configuration for 'build rstan' as to what you think is appropriate.  Thanks. 

--
Jiqiang
